headline: Facilities director presents $10.6 million Trane energy plan, with solar panels planned for Reiche and Presumpscot roofs.
summary: The facilities director said about $600,000 of the work is rebates, and solar is the largest item at about 400,000. The lowest of five Reiche roof bids came in at $1.3 million, and about 700 thousand dollars more is needed against the $600,000 budget. Committee review is set for December 14th, with a board vote on January 12th. The board also approved the election of three probationary teachers.
decisions: Approved the election of three probationary teachers, by roll call.
Approved entering executive session to consult with legal counsel, unanimously.
discussion: Trane energy contract: The facilities director presented about $10.6 million in phase one work and said solar on the Reiche and Presumpscot roofs depends on whether each roof can hold the panels. Members asked whether individual items can be removed, and the director said Trane must show savings for each one.

Reiche roof and capital plan: Presenters said the lowest of five Reiche roof bids came in at $1.3 million, against a $600,000 budget. Presenters also said the capital request has been held to an artificial number of about $3 million a year, and asked the board for guidance on how much financing to take on.

Enrollment decline: The senior director of data and technology said district enrollment fell about 9% over the last decade, with almost 3% in the last year. Members asked about students who left and later returned, and how many multilingual students leave for other districts or states.

Chronic absenteeism and suspensions: The assistant superintendent for secondary schools reported high school chronic absenteeism at 24%, down from 26% last year, and middle school at 12%. Suspensions were 33 as of November 1, compared with about 129 at this point last year.

Public comment on climate: Speakers from the Portland High environmental club asked for solar panels on school roofs and a district-wide sustainability plan. Other speakers asked the district to lower building emissions and keep climate action a priority in the upcoming facilities report.

decision_evidence.quote: Um so, I would be looking for the motion for the consideration and action to approve the personnel items listed, the election of teacher candidates probationary. ... So that motion passes.

I'd make the motion for the consideration and action to enter into executive session pursuant to 1 MRSA 405 6E, uh, to consult with legal counsel. Is there a second? Thank you, um, Board Member Brydon. Uh, all those in favor? Okay. That is unanimous.

decision_titles: Executive session to consult with legal counsel
